content.title: 3-1-4-2. Temporary uses by zoning district.
content.summary:
A.	Generally. The temporary land uses that are allowed in each zoning district are set out in Table 3-1-4-2, Temporary Uses by Zoning District. The "T" indicates that the temporary land use is allowed subject to standards referenced at the end of the row.
(Ord. No. 4905, § 25, 8-19-2025)
